subject: Disability Awareness and Reopening Support Planning
overview: The subcommittee discussed expanding the high school's Common Ground reverse inclusion model and disability awareness coursework into the middle schools, as well as planning social-emotional and behavioral supports for students returning to school after pandemic-related disruptions.

items.title: Introductions and Meeting Overview
items.summary: Chair Melanie McLaughlin opened the remote meeting and participants introduced themselves.

items.title: Disability Awareness, Common Ground Program, and Inclusion
items.summary: Staff and committee members discussed an EPIC guest presentation on ableism, Susanna Campbell's disability awareness professional development course, and ongoing efforts to expand the Common Ground reverse inclusion model from Medford High School into the middle schools as a potential elective or program.

items.title: Behavioral Health, Trauma-Informed Planning, and Reopening Supports
items.summary: Parents and administrators discussed student mental health needs, art and music therapy, upcoming district listening sessions for reopening, and parent concerns regarding in-person versus consult-based behavioral support services.
